PREFIX wfkg: <https://example.org/wfkg/v1#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?articleId ?publishedAt ?availableAt ?evidenceId ?evidenceText ?eventId ?effectiveTradingDate WHERE {
 ?a wfkg:articleId ?articleId; wfkg:publishedAt ?publishedAt; wfkg:availableAt ?availableAt; wfkg:reports ?e .
 ?v wfkg:evidenceId ?evidenceId; wfkg:evidenceText ?evidenceText; wfkg:extractedFrom ?a; wfkg:supports ?e .
 ?e wfkg:eventId ?eventId; wfkg:effectiveTradingDate ?effectiveTradingDate . } ORDER BY ?publishedAt ?articleId

PREFIX wfkg: <https://example.org/wfkg/v1#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?eventId ?company ?stock ?ticker ?impactType WHERE {
 ?e wfkg:eventId ?eventId; wfkg:involvesCompany ?company; wfkg:hasEventStockCandidate ?c .
 ?company wfkg:hasStock ?stock . ?stock wfkg:tickerSymbol ?ticker . ?c wfkg:candidateStock ?stock; wfkg:impactType ?impactType . } ORDER BY ?eventId

PREFIX wfkg: <https://example.org/wfkg/v1#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?eventId ?candidate ?status ?day ?source ?extraction ?linking ?relation ?confidence ?strength ?candidateScore WHERE {
 ?candidate a wfkg:EventStockCandidate; wfkg:forEvent ?e; wfkg:candidateStatus ?status; wfkg:sourceConfidence ?source; wfkg:extractionConfidence ?extraction; wfkg:linkingConfidence ?linking; wfkg:relationConfidence ?relation; wfkg:confidenceScore ?confidence; wfkg:relationStrength ?strength; wfkg:candidateScore ?candidateScore .
 ?e wfkg:eventId ?eventId; wfkg:effectiveTradingDate ?day . } ORDER BY ?eventId

PREFIX wfkg: <https://example.org/wfkg/v1#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?newEvent ?oldEvent WHERE {?new wfkg:clarifies ?old; wfkg:eventId ?newEvent . ?old wfkg:eventId ?oldEvent} ORDER BY ?newEvent

PREFIX wfkg: <https://example.org/wfkg/v1#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?eventId ?reactionId ?ar ?car ?impactScore ?reactionWeight ?signedWeight ?availableAt WHERE {
 ?c wfkg:forEvent ?e; wfkg:hasReaction ?r . ?e wfkg:eventId ?eventId .
 ?r wfkg:reactionId ?reactionId; wfkg:abnormalReturn ?ar; wfkg:cumulativeAbnormalReturn ?car; wfkg:impactScore ?impactScore; wfkg:reactionWeight ?reactionWeight; wfkg:signedWeight ?signedWeight; wfkg:availableAt ?availableAt . } ORDER BY ?eventId
